authority: Scott M. Carney, Harmonic Trading Volume Two, Chapter 6 RSI BAMM
Scott M. Carney, Harmonic Trading Volume Three, RSI BAMM Types
scope: Source requirements for RSI BAMM sequencing, X-A Confirmation Point projection, and harmonic-pattern confluence.

volume_two_complex_sequence.source_ref: Volume Two, Chapter 6, bullish printed pp.10-57; bearish printed pp.60-88
steps: complete W-type bullish or M-type bearish complex structure entirely in the extreme zone
define Trigger Bar at the 30/70 extreme-zone exit
observe reaction of RSI and price
require RSI reaction to at least the 50 midpoint before the final retest
complete final price/RSI divergence and project 1.13 or 1.618 X-A Confirmation Point
coordinate the Confirmation Point with a distinct harmonic-pattern completion
volume_two_complex_sequence.bullish_divergence: price makes a nominal lower low while the second oversold RSI impulse reverses above the prior RSI low
volume_two_complex_sequence.bearish_divergence: price makes a nominal higher high while the second overbought RSI impulse reverses below the prior RSI high

projection.x: prior price extreme associated with the initial RSI structure
projection.a: most favorable price extreme of the initial reaction after the Trigger Bar and before the secondary extreme test begins
projection.bearish_source_text: Volume Two explicitly calls the final spillover a 1.13/1.618 extension of the initial breakdown X-A
projection.bullish_basis: mirror image of the same X-A reaction shown throughout the bullish figures

volume_two_complex_sequence.retracement_pattern_exception: On the 1.13 side, a distinct retracement harmonic pattern may complete before the minimum 1.13 extension and take precedence if coordinated with the successful impulsive RSI retest.

volume_three_types.confirmation_relation: price and RSI second extremes both confirm in the reversal direction (bullish higher/higher; bearish lower/lower)
volume_three_types.divergence_relation: RSI improves/weakens while price makes a nominal new trend extreme (bullish RSI higher with price lower; bearish RSI lower with price higher)

engineering_operationalization.complex_classifier: A W/M source description has no published bar-by-bar pivot algorithm. v2 conservatively requires an internal turn entirely inside the extreme zone before the 30/70 exit.
engineering_operationalization.no_lookahead: Structure classification waits for the 30/70 exit; X-A reaction anchor A is frozen before the secondary extreme begins; the sequence is emitted only on the secondary extreme exit.
engineering_operationalization.projection_fail_closed: If a directionally valid X-A reaction cannot be built, indicator sequence remains visible but source confirmation is blocked.

source_limits: A single oversold/overbought reading is not RSI BAMM.
A second extreme test without an intervening RSI 50 midpoint reaction is not RSI BAMM.
A complex second extreme test does not satisfy the Volume Three type contract.
RSI BAMM is confirmation/execution evidence and cannot create or repair harmonic geometry or Source Raw PRZ.
The optional Acceleration Trigger is outside the core completion state and must remain a separate later enhancement.
